note: How a unit is made to travel, in place of what a receiving end would otherwise choose for it. A receiving end takes these as they stand and stops choosing a path of its own while they hold.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: How fast the unit travels along the path, in world units a second, standing in for its own pace.

fields.name: gravity
fields.note: How sharply the unit arcs through the air along the way. Zero where it keeps to the ground.

fields.name: arcFromX
fields.note: Where the arc begins, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: arcFromZ
fields.note: Where it begins, along the other.

fields.name: keepFacing
fields.note: Whether the unit holds the way it already faces rather than turning to face where it is going.

fields.name: follows
fields.note: The unit this one is made to follow, or zero where it follows none.

fields.name: followDistance
fields.note: How far from that unit it is made to stay, in world units. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: followBackDistance
fields.note: How far behind that unit it is made to stay, in world units. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: followTime
fields.note: How long the following runs, in seconds.
